items.title: 2027 Grad Floral Badge
items.alt: Gold 2027 Grad lettering on an ivory oval badge topped by a black mortarboard and decorated with a red rose and eucalyptus.
items.description: The asymmetrical flower spray follows the lower left of the slim gold frame beneath the cap's full tassel.

items.title: My Next Chapter 2027 Book Steps
items.alt: Three cream books arranged as steps toward a gold star beneath the words My Next Chapter, with 2027 on the front book.
items.description: A curled gold ribbon links the stepped books and their gold-edged pages beneath the arched message.

items.title: Class of 2027 Varsity Pennant
items.alt: Burgundy Class of pennant above large navy varsity 2027 numerals, with a gold pole and tassel at the side.
items.description: Cream inset strokes and wide gold borders keep the angular year clear beneath the triangular flag.

items.title: Ruby and Gold Beveled 2027
items.alt: Upright ruby-red 2027 numerals with broad gold beveled edges and thick metallic sidewalls.
items.description: The tall serif digits share a straight baseline, with light catching the polished gold edges around the open zero.

items.title: 2027 Let's Go Comic Burst
items.alt: Coral 2027 and navy Let's Go lettering inside a gold comic burst with two lightning accents.
items.description: Thick navy outlines and irregular pointed rays give the compact message a lively sticker shape.

items.title: Roll into 2027 Skateboard
items.alt: Teal skateboard with pink 2027 numerals and yellow stars beneath large pink Roll into lettering.
items.description: The complete wheels and trucks remain visible under the angled deck, whose brown edge adds a layered detail.
